items.topic_zh: 关于健康和生活方式的建议
items.claim_zh: 他认为健康的生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好的睡眠和适度锻炼。
items.article_body:
The South Asian Literature and Art (SALA) Festival 2026 opened on September 26 at Menlo College in Atherton, California. This year’s theme is “The Global Gaze, The South Asian Soul.” Day 1 brought together voices from science, literature, mathematics, art, and journalism. I want to showcase the conversations with Nobel Prize laureate Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan, mathematician and novelist Manil Suri, and journalist, columnist, and author Shobhaa De.
Their disciplines are radically different, but their conversations touched on several universal questions: How do we make the most of a finite life? Where do our creative impulses come from? How does childhood shape the adult voice? And what does it mean to remain authentic?
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan: The Science of Mortality
Dr. Venki Ramakrishnan brought a Nobel-level perspective with a gripping lecture on the science of death, aging, and mortality.
As a Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry for his work on the structure and function of the ribosome, he made complex scientific ideas understandable to a lay audience. His core message challenged the current enthusiasm surrounding biohacking, cryopreservation of human brains, peptide treatments, and other promises of extending youth. Rather than approaching mortality through commercial hype, he encouraged the audience to understand aging through the lens of molecular biology. He discussed senescence and the shortening of telomeres, the prevalence of “skinny fat” among Indians and obesity in African Americans in the United States, and the relationship to stress.
An audience question sparked an important debate on lifespan and healthspan. The goal, he suggested, should not simply be to increase the number of years we live. What matters is the quality of those years. A longer life accompanied by frailty and cognitive decline is not necessarily the outcome we should be pursuing.
He also talked about the prime of life and creativity, particularly the period between ages 20 and 30. He cited examples such as Tolstoy writing War and Peace and the extraordinary creative output of Schubert, Mozart, Stravinsky, and other greats.
In a world increasingly obsessed with quantified health, Dr. Ramakrishnan offered surprisingly simple advice. Rather than relying on the data churned out of Oura rings and other devices, he recommended three timeless principles: Eat in moderation. Get good, restful sleep. Exercise in moderation. The idea that “what does not kill you makes you stronger” became part of a broader reflection on resilience and the value of living with purpose.
He used that the value of life lies in the pursuit of our ideals, even though our physical efforts eventually disintegrate.
Manil Suri: Mathematics, Memory and the Urgency to Write
Manil Suri is a rare talent who bridges higher mathematics and literature. A distinguished professor of mathematics at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, he is also the acclaimed author of The Death of Vishnu, The Age of Shiva, and The City of Devi, as well as the memoir A Room in Bombay. He has also explored the relationship between mathematics and the universe in The Big Bang of Numbers.
Suri spoke about his desire to be surrounded by writers and poets. Although mathematics was his professional discipline, he felt that he was missing a dimension and wanted the companionship of the humanities.
He returned to a childhood habit of writing and initially committed himself to completing one story each year. “I got lucky and got published,” he said. When asked about the word “luck,” he explained that luck is about being in the right place at the right time.
Despite Suri’s modesty, his literary success is the product of discipline. Suri’s writing is deeply rooted in his childhood memories of Mumbai. He wrote regularly to his mother, who saved 2,711 of his letters. “One autumn, I just read all those old letters,” he recalled. “I picked up pieces of dialogue and memories hidden somewhere. They just need a trigger to come rushing back.”
Those letters became an unexpected archive of memory. His relationship with his mother and his experiences growing up in Mumbai formed the foundation of A Room in Bombay.
As someone who also grew up in Mumbai’s apartment complexes, I found his reflections deeply resonant. Many of us who grew up in those spaces will recognize the shared experiences, the proximity of neighbors, the sounds, the conversations, the sense of living among an interwoven tapestry of people’s lives.
When he signed my copy of The Death of Vishnu, it felt like a beautiful connection to those Mumbai roots.
We also discussed the urgency of writing what is clamoring to be written. That urgency is something many creative people understand: the feeling that an idea has become so insistent that it must find its way onto the page.
Suri has developed a disciplined routine around this impulse. He writes a sentence at night before going to bed and expands on it in the morning. He has also said that he can write before breakfast. Even one line. He has told his mind, “Today you will be writing.”
He believes the original thought is often the best. Language can be polished later.
His editing process is equally disciplined. For his memoir, he cut approximately 50 percent of a 140,000-word draft to find the story’s core.
He has become more adept at what he calls “self-editing.”
“When you are starting out, you tend to be self-indulgent,” he says. “You have to ask yourself: what is it that is driving the narrative forward?”
Shobhaa De: Finding the Courage to Use Your Voice
Shobhaa De stands as a pioneering Indian columnist, former supermodel, and bestselling novelist, often dubbed “India’s Jackie Collins.” In the 1970s and 1980s, she co-founded and edited legendary pop-culture magazines such as Stardust. Her novels, including Socialite Evenings and Starry Nights, boldly exposed both the glamorous and darker sides of urban India and Bollywood. Her voice has always been her defining characteristic: sharp, provocative, and unapologetic.
Her lecture on her latest book, The Sensual Self, moderated by Dr. Anjal Arondekari, had the audience in stitches. But beneath the humor, in an interview with me, was a thoughtful reflection on childhood, independence, family responsibility, gender, and the courage to take risks.
De’s fierce independence was forged early. As the youngest child in her family, she had greater freedom of self-expression than her older siblings. Yet she also felt intensely duty-bound to her parents. That tension between freedom and responsibility influenced the choices she made.
“Looking back, I could have taken many more chances,” she reflected. “But in a way, I was inhibited by not upsetting my parents more than they were already upset.
Her message to younger people is therefore deeply personal: “Just be reckless. Don’t play it safe. No safe bets.”
She remembered herself at five years old as “quite adorable,” but also “pampered, entitled, and a bit too obedient,” and wondered what she would tell that little girl today. “Enjoy being five years old, ” Shobhaa said, imagining herself.
Shobhaa said she did not have one “mentor” but the many people she admired in college and during her early journalism career, those who gave her “fantastic” breaks.
My friends and I grew up curled up on sofas reading her scandalous Stardust columns.
My father appreciated her tongue-in-cheek outspoken spirit. During our conversation, De revealed a magnetic aura that naturally encouraged people to open up to her.
We spoke about the troubling tendency among women in the West to muffle their own voices and shrink themselves to fit into a man’s world.
“There is no such thing as a man’s world. Don’t give it importance.”
She also spoke about ageism and the ways societies can impose limitations on women. Her message was that women must learn to rely on their own resources and continue to seek inspiration within themselves. Do not give up on yourself. Accept genuine care with grace but do not allow society to put you in a cage. On gender and identity, De made another characteristically memorable declaration. “I want to be reborn as a woman in the next seven lives.”
The three conversations explore different aspects of life: its limits, the power of memory, and the courage to express oneself. Together, they suggest that creativity grows from curiosity, personal history, and self-expression, connecting the global perspective with the South Asian experience.
With roots in Georgia and the Bay Area, and her heart still tethered to a childhood mango tree in Mumbai, India, Monita Soni approaches writing as a contemplative practice. A path to honor humanity. She has published hundreds of movie reviews, book critiques, poems, and essays, and contributed to combined literary works. Her two books are “My Light Reflections” and “Flow Through My Heart.” You can hear her commentaries on Sundial Writers Corner, WLRH 89.3 FM.

items.title_zh: 科学、记忆与寻找声音：2026年南亚文学与艺术节的三场对话
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们对健康生活方式的看法。核心论点是健康的生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好的睡眠和适度锻炼。科学家们强调，适度饮食可以帮助维持身体健康，良好的睡眠有助于记忆和认知功能，而适度锻炼则能增强身体素质和心理健康。这些观点通过科学研究和数据支持，指出了健康生活方式对个人和社会的重要性，呼吁人们关注并实践这些健康建议。
items.l1_lead: 健康生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼，这对个人和社会的健康至关重要。
items.l2_summary:
在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们围绕健康生活方式展开了深入的对话，探讨了适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼对身体和心理健康的重要性。研究表明，适度饮食不仅有助于维持身体健康，还能有效降低慢性疾病的风险。科学家们强调，合理的营养摄入能够为身体提供必要的能量和营养素，从而促进整体健康。

此外，良好的睡眠被认为是提升记忆和认知功能的关键因素。研究显示，成年人每晚应保证7到9小时的睡眠，以便大脑在睡眠过程中进行信息整理和记忆巩固。缺乏睡眠不仅会影响学习能力，还可能导致情绪波动和心理健康问题。

适度锻炼同样被视为健康生活方式的重要组成部分。科学家指出，规律的身体活动能够增强心肺功能，提高身体素质，并有助于减轻压力和焦虑。根据相关数据，成年人每周应至少进行150分钟的中等强度锻炼，以达到最佳的健康效果。

通过这些科学研究和数据支持，科学家们呼吁公众关注健康生活方式的重要性，并积极实践这些建议，以促进个人和社会的整体健康。健康的生活方式不仅能改善个体的生活质量，还有助于降低医疗成本，提升社会的整体福祉。因此，适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼应成为每个人日常生活中不可或缺的部分。

items.title: Oxygenaging: A Physiological Framework for Geroscience.
items.body: The stepwise movement of oxygen from the atmosphere to the mitochondria, the "oxygen cascade", is one of the most tightly regulated systems in physiology. Despite decades of mechanistic study, it has remained quite unexplored in Geroscience. This oversight should be reconsidered. In young organisms, hypoxic stress (whether environmental or tissue-specific) activates a complex adaptive response to preserve energetic stability via restraining anabolic pathways, optimizing mitochondrial performance, and reinforcing cellular quality control systems. With advancing age, angiostatic signaling increases, endothelial metabolism becomes dysregulated, and overall alveolar ventilation and pulmonary gas exchange (ventilation-perfusion matching and diffusion capacity) become less efficient. These changes promote microvascular rarefaction and low-grade but persistent mismatches between oxygen delivery and demand at the tissue level, ultimately destabilizing cellular function. In this review, we propose that the gradual erosion of oxygen homeostasis is not simply a byproduct of aging, but also a driver of molecular damage and functional decline. We examine the aging oxygen cascade through the framework of resilience biology, focusing on mechanisms such as mitochondrial electron leaks, oxidative stress amplification, iron dyshomeostasis, ferroptosis, and epigenetic remodeling. We also discuss interventions that alter oxygen availability, such as intermittent hypoxia, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and hypoxic-hyperoxic training. These approaches demonstrate adaptive potential, but they also highlight the narrow margin between beneficial stress and injury. We propose "Oxygenaging" as a unifying framework in which aging associates with the progressive loss of equilibrium across the oxygen cascade, linking systemic oxygen transport to mitochondrial function, genomic stability, and cellular resilience.
items.authors: Donega S, Fishbein KW, Dominelli P, Herman AB, de Cabo R, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 氧气衰老：衰老科学的生理框架
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了氧气从大气到线粒体的逐步转移过程，即“氧气级联”，在衰老科学中的重要性。尽管已有数十年的机制研究，但这一领域仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下会激活复杂的适应性反应，以维持能量稳定，然而随着年龄增长，血管抑制信号增强，内皮代谢失调，导致肺泡通气和气体交换效率降低。这些变化促进了微血管稀疏和组织层面氧气供需不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。我们提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。文章通过韧性生物学框架分析衰老氧气级联，重点关注线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等机制。
items.l1_lead: 氧气稳态的逐渐破坏是衰老的驱动因素，影响细胞功能并导致组织层面氧气供需不匹配。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了氧气在生物体内的转移过程，特别是从大气到线粒体的“氧气级联”在衰老科学中的重要性。尽管已有数十年的研究揭示了氧气在细胞代谢中的关键作用，但这一领域仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下能够激活复杂的适应性反应，以维持能量稳定。然而，随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号逐渐增强，内皮代谢出现失调，导致肺泡通气和气体交换效率的降低。这些生理变化进一步促进了微血管的稀疏和组织层面氧气供需的不匹配，最终破坏了细胞功能。

研究提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，更是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。文章通过韧性生物学框架分析了衰老过程中氧气级联的变化，重点关注了线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等机制。这些机制相互作用，导致细胞在氧气供应不足的情况下，逐渐出现功能衰退和损伤。

总的来说，氧气的稳态在衰老过程中扮演着至关重要的角色，其逐步破坏不仅影响细胞的代谢和功能，还可能成为衰老相关疾病的潜在机制。因此，深入理解氧气级联的生理过程及其在衰老中的作用，将为未来的衰老研究和相关疾病的治疗提供新的视角和思路。

items.title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.
items.journal: The British journal of psychiatry : the journal of mental science
items.authors: Catalán A, Swidzinski S, McCutcheon RA, Aymerich C, Pedruzo B, Knox S, Swidzinska P, Tsaligopoulou A, Short R, Carter B, Ratheesh A, Quattrone D, Fearon P, Fusar-Poli P, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
items.title_zh: 初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本文通过系统评价和随机效应荟萃分析，探讨了初次接触早期干预服务（EIS）时，情感性精神障碍患者的相对流行率。研究纳入了符合DSM/ICD标准的治疗过的首次发作精神病（FEP）人群，共计83项研究（N = 30,946；平均年龄24.95岁；女性占34.78%）。结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%。其中，情感性精神分裂症占7.4%，而精神分裂症是最常见的诊断，合并比例为45.5%。该研究强调了情感性精神障碍在EIS中的重要性，呼吁对其进行更深入的关注与研究。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中占18.0%，强调了该群体的重要性及需加强关注与研究。
items.l2_summary: 本文通过系统评价和随机效应荟萃分析，研究了初次接触早期干预服务（Early Intervention Services, EIS）时，情感性精神障碍患者的相对流行率。研究纳入了符合《精神障碍诊断与统计手册》（DSM）和《国际疾病分类》（ICD）标准的首次发作精神病（First Episode Psychosis, FEP）人群，共计83项研究，样本量达到30,946人，平均年龄为24.95岁，其中女性占34.78%。研究结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%。在具体的诊断中，情感性精神分裂症的合并比例为7.4%，而精神分裂症则是最常见的诊断，其合并比例高达45.5%。这些数据表明，情感性精神障碍在EIS中占有重要地位，提示临床工作者和研究者应对此类障碍给予更多关注与深入研究。研究强调了在早期干预服务中，识别和处理情感性精神障碍的重要性，以期改善患者的预后和生活质量。

items.title: Cannabis use is associated with increased risk of violence: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Cannabis use is a known risk factor for adverse mental health outcomes, including psychosis, which is frequently associated with aggression. However, the specific impact of cannabis use on the risk of violence remains unclear. This meta-analysis, conducted according to PRISMA guidelines, synthesized evidence from 63 peer-reviewed studies (N = 265,079) identified via MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO searches up to November 2024 to clarify the link between cannabis use and violence, either as a perpetrator or as a victim. Random-effects models revealed that cannabis users are at a significantly higher risk of perpetrating violent acts. This association was observed in both psychiatric patients (OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61) and the general population (OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41), and remained significant across both longitudinal (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28) and cross-sectional (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40) study designs. There was an especially large effect for violence involving a criminal conviction in both general (OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53) and psychiatric (OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22) populations. Furthermore, cannabis use was significantly associated with an increased risk of becoming a victim of violence (OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60), a risk more pronounced in females and mixed-gender cohorts compared to males. This meta-analysis indicates an increased risk of violence, especially that resulting in a criminal conviction, among cannabis users. It also highlights the potential of cannabis use as a target for interventions to decrease violence, and underscores the need for routine assessment of cannabis use among psychiatric patients.
items.authors: Trotta G, Rodriguez V, Marino P, Gurmesa M, Spinazzola E, Li Z, Alameda L, Di Forti M, Murray R, Vassos E.
items.title_zh: 大麻使用与暴力风险增加相关：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了大麻使用对暴力风险的影响，分析了63项经过同行评审的研究（N = 265,079），以明确大麻使用与暴力行为（作为施暴者或受害者）之间的关系。结果显示，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者（OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61）和普通人群（OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41）均表现出这一趋势。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），这一关联均显著。涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为在普通人群（OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22）中效果尤为显著。此外，大麻使用与成为暴力受害者的风险显著相关（OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60），女性和混合性别群体的风险更高。该荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加密切相关。
items.l1_lead: 大麻使用显著增加施暴和成为暴力受害者的风险，尤其在精神病患者和女性中表现更为明显。
items.l2_summary:
本研究通过系统评估63项经过同行评审的研究（样本量N = 265,079），探讨了大麻使用与暴力风险之间的关系。结果表明，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者的施暴风险比值（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群的施暴风险比值为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），这一关联均表现出显著性。此外，涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为在普通人群（OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22）中尤为显著，显示出大麻使用与暴力行为之间的强关联性。

研究还发现，大麻使用与成为暴力受害者的风险显著相关，风险比值为1.49（95% CI 1.38-1.60），其中女性和混合性别群体的风险更高。这些数据表明，大麻使用不仅增加了施暴的可能性，同时也使个体更易成为暴力行为的受害者。综上所述，该荟萃分析明确指出，大麻使用与暴力风险的增加密切相关，提示在公共卫生和政策制定中应重视大麻使用对暴力行为的潜在影响。

items.title: Loss of Splicing Homeostasis as a Hallmark of Aging.
items.body: Alternative splicing is a fundamental mechanism that ensures accurate gene expression, supports cellular adaptability, and expands protein diversity beyond the limits of a fixed gene pool. With aging, splicing fidelity weakens, contributing to decline in RNA homeostasis and disrupting essential cellular functions, including mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, genome stability, and immune regulation, and in turn accelerating tissue and organ dysfunction. Evidence from senescent cells, aged tissues, and model organisms shows that altered levels of splicing factors and increased RNA polymerase II elongation rates impair co-transcriptional splicing and promote mis-spliced isoforms that reinforce senescence and drive pathology. Dysfunction of RNA-binding proteins further contributes to aberrant splicing, linking splicing defects to age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, sarcopenia, and neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic strategies to correct splicing defects, such as antisense oligonucleotides, RNA interference, CRISPR-Cas systems, ADAR-mediated editing, and RNA aptamers, can restore a homeostatic balance of mRNA isoforms. However, major challenges remain, including distinguishing adaptive physiological from pathological splicing 'noise' and achieving targeted delivery to tissues. Despite these obstacles, RNA splicing dysregulation represents a promising avenue to extend health span by reestablishing homeostatic RNA programs, and reinforces the idea that "transcriptomic instability" is a hallmark of aging.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Harries LW, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 剪接稳态丧失作为衰老的标志
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损，进而影响线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能，加速组织和器官的功能衰退。研究表明，衰老细胞、老化组织和模型生物中剪接因子的水平变化及RNA聚合酶II延伸速率增加，导致共转录剪接受损，产生错误剪接的异构体，进一步加剧衰老和病理状态。此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也与剪接缺陷相关，连接了衰老与动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等神经退行性疾病。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统等，有望恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡，但仍面临诸多挑战。
items.l1_lead: 替代剪接的准确性下降与衰老密切相关，影响细胞功能并加速组织衰退，揭示了剪接稳态丧失作为衰老的重要标志。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性以及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性逐渐下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）受损。这种变化对细胞的关键功能产生了深远影响，包括线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等，最终加速了组织和器官的功能衰退。研究表明，在衰老细胞、老化组织和模型生物中，剪接因子的水平发生变化，同时RNA聚合酶II的延伸速率增加，这导致了共转录剪接受损，产生错误剪接的异构体，进一步加剧了衰老和病理状态。

此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也与剪接缺陷密切相关，这一现象将衰老与多种疾病联系在一起，包括动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症以及阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰和CRISPR-Cas系统等，显示出恢复mRNA异构体稳态平衡的潜力，但在实际应用中仍面临诸多挑战。综上所述，剪接稳态的丧失不仅是衰老的一个重要标志，也为衰老相关疾病的研究和治疗提供了新的思路。

items.title: Ferroptotic propagation: from single-cell execution to tissue-scale death programs.
items.body: Ferroptosis has long been regarded as a cell-autonomous form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation. Recent work, however, suggests that ferroptotic commitment can extend beyond the initiating cell, spreading to neighboring cells and, in some contexts, across tissue-scale distances. Multiple, non-mutually exclusive modes of contagion have now been described, including reactive oxygen species-triggered death waves, direct membrane contact-dependent transfer, and extracellular vesicle-mediated paracrine signaling. These findings redefine ferroptosis from a single-cell execution pathway into a spatially coordinated, multicellular process. In this perspective, we integrate mechanistic insights with experimental evidence on ferroptotic contagion and propose a unifying, multiscale framework in which distinct modes of transmission operate over different spatial scales, from short-range membrane transfer to longer-range oxidative and extracellular relay mechanisms. We discuss how nonlinear redox amplification, membrane biophysics, and tissue architecture together determine the dynamics, limits, and patterning of ferroptotic injury in vivo. This emerging framework has important implications for developmental tissue remodeling, the progression of organ injury, and ferroptosis-based cancer therapy. More broadly, defining how ferroptotic contagion is initiated, constrained, and manipulated therapeutically may help establish ferroptosis as a fundamental organizing principle for understanding tissue-level regulation and pathological escalation.
items.authors: Tang D, Kang R, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 铁死亡传播：从单细胞执行到组织规模死亡程序
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（Ferroptosis）被认为是一种由铁依赖的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式。近期研究表明，铁死亡的承诺不仅限于启动细胞，还可以传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织规模的距离。研究描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括活性氧（reactive oxygen species）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传递。这些发现将铁死亡重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程。本文整合了关于铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，阐明不同传播模式在不同空间尺度上的运作，从短距离膜转移到更长距离的氧化和细胞外中继机制。我们讨论了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。该框架对发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡不仅是单细胞的死亡机制，还能通过多种方式在邻近细胞和组织间传播，重新定义为一种空间协调的多细胞过程。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（Ferroptosis）是一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式，近期的研究揭示了其传播特性，显示铁死亡不仅限于启动细胞，还能影响邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织规模的距离。这一发现重新定义了铁死亡为一种空间协调的多细胞过程，涉及多种非互斥的传播模式，包括活性氧（reactive oxygen species）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传递。

研究整合了铁死亡传播的机制洞察与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，阐明了不同传播模式在不同空间尺度上的运作。这一框架涵盖了从短距离膜转移到更长距离的氧化和细胞外中继机制，强调了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这些机制的相互作用不仅影响细胞的死亡过程，还可能在发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗中发挥重要作用。

通过对铁死亡传播的深入研究，科学家们能够更好地理解其在生理和病理状态下的作用，为未来的治疗策略提供新的思路。这些发现为铁死亡在细胞间的传播提供了新的视角，揭示了其在多细胞生物体中的复杂性和重要性，预示着在相关疾病的治疗中，针对铁死亡的干预可能会带来新的突破。

items.title: Molecular damage associated with ageing drives inflammation in cardiovascular disease.
items.body: Chronic inflammation has long been recognized as a major risk factor for and a causal contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, advances in omics technologies and deepening insights into CVD pathogenesis have expanded our understanding of the underlying mechanisms. Inflammation is now seen not as an isolated cause, but as one of several biological responses to cumulative tissue damage over time. In this Review, we propose that inflammation initially functions as a resilience mechanism, acting to resolve molecular and cellular damage driven by environmental stressors and intrinsic age-related entropy. With ageing, however, this protective response can become dysregulated and maladaptive, promoting collateral pathological changes. We illustrate this theory through two examples, atherosclerosis and age-related impairment of tissue perfusion, and support these conceptual models using proteomic data from large population studies with cardiovascular outcomes. Our findings reaffirm the central role of inflammation in CVD pathophysiology, but also indicate that the upstream biological driver of inflammation is molecular damage that is either not readily prevented or repaired by inadequate resilience mechanisms. Understanding the coordination of these responses offers new opportunities for targeted prevention and treatment of CVD.
items.authors: Herman AB, Candia J, Wilson DM, Donega S, Picard M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症
items.summary_zh: 慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和致病因素。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积性组织损伤的生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在解决环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，促进病理变化的发生。通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，我们阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究中的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。我们的研究重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时指出炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这些损伤无法通过不足的韧性机制有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。
items.l1_lead: 衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症，提示炎症反应的失调可能促进病理变化，为CVD的预防和治疗提供新的思路。
items.l2_summary:
慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和致病因素。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积性组织损伤的生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种韧性机制，旨在应对环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，进而促进病理变化的发生。

通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，本文阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究中的蛋白质组学数据支持这些概念模型。这些研究强调了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时指出炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，而这些损伤往往无法通过不足的韧性机制有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调机制为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。

总之，本文的研究强调了衰老相关的分子损伤在心血管疾病中的重要性，揭示了炎症作为一种生物反应的复杂性，并为未来的研究和临床干预提供了新的视角。

items.title: Immune aging biomarkers for clinical trials.
items.body: Aging profoundly remodels the immune system, impairing defense, repair and homeostatic function across tissues. Because the immune system operates in every organ, its deterioration has been proposed to drive or exacerbate systemic dysfunction and accelerate overall biological aging, making it an attractive biomarker and target for geroscience-guided trials. Despite this central role, there is no consensus on how to quantify immune aging, especially in clinical trials. Here, we establish a translational framework to identify immune aging biomarkers for this purpose. We define five evaluation criteria for immune aging biomarkers and apply these to candidate biomarkers, discussing their utility in the context of a major international healthspan competition, XPRIZE Healthspan. Metrics encapsulating multidimensional aspects of immune function, inflammaging scores and functional assays performed best against our selection criteria. Finally, we identify promising emerging measures, together with critical gaps that must be addressed to develop reliable, predictive biomarkers of human immune competence. Our framework provides a coherent path toward actionable and clinically meaningful immune aging biomarkers capable of quantifying immune fitness and resilience, and accelerating the clinical translation of geroscience-guided interventions.
items.authors: Cipriano A, Justice J, Poganik JR, Moqri M, Abudayyeh OO, Gootenberg J, Haynes L, Levin Y, Martin-Herranz DE, Akbar AN, Mannick J, Pawelec G, Shen-Orr SS, Tsang J, Wagner W, Merad M, Gnjatic S, Gellhorn A, Corley MJ, Kuc

items.title_zh: 免疫衰老生物标志物在临床试验中的应用
items.summary_zh: 免疫系统在衰老过程中发生显著重塑，影响防御、修复和稳态功能，进而加速整体生物衰老。尽管免疫衰老在系统功能障碍中扮演重要角色，但目前尚无统一的量化标准，尤其是在临床试验中。本文建立了一个转化框架，以识别免疫衰老生物标志物，定义了五项评估标准，并将其应用于候选生物标志物，探讨其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能测定在评估标准中表现最佳。最后，本文识别出有前景的新兴测量方法，并指出开发可靠预测人类免疫能力生物标志物所需解决的关键问题。该框架为量化免疫健康和韧性提供了可行路径，促进了衰老科学指导干预措施的临床转化。
items.l1_lead: 本文建立了免疫衰老生物标志物的评估框架，识别出多维免疫功能指标等关键标准，为临床试验中的免疫健康量化提供了可行路径。
items.l2_summary:
免疫系统在衰老过程中经历显著的重塑，这种变化不仅影响了机体的防御、修复和稳态功能，还加速了整体生物衰老的进程。尽管免疫衰老在系统功能障碍中发挥着重要作用，但目前尚缺乏统一的量化标准，尤其是在临床试验的应用中。为了解决这一问题，本文建立了一个转化框架，旨在识别免疫衰老生物标志物，并定义了五项评估标准。这些标准被应用于候选生物标志物的评估，探讨其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。

在评估标准中，多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能测定表现出最佳的评估效果。这些指标能够有效反映个体的免疫健康状况和衰老程度，为临床干预提供了重要依据。此外，本文还识别出了一些有前景的新兴测量方法，并指出了在开发可靠的预测人类免疫能力生物标志物过程中需要解决的关键问题。这些问题的解决将为量化免疫健康和韧性提供可行的路径，从而促进衰老科学在临床干预中的转化应用。

总之，本文的研究为免疫衰老生物标志物的识别和应用提供了系统的框架和实用的评估标准，推动了衰老相关研究的进展，并为未来的临床试验奠定了基础。通过这些努力，能够更好地理解和应对免疫衰老带来的挑战，进而改善老年人的健康状况和生活质量。

items.title: Translating ferroptosis into oncology: challenges, opportunities and future directions.
items.body: Ferroptosis is an oxidative, lipid peroxidation-driven form of regulated cell death that occurs when antioxidant and organelle-protective systems are compromised. Increasing evidence implicates ferroptosis as a process that can exert both tumour-suppressive and tumour-promoting effects depending on cellular context at multiple stages of cancer evolution (from tumour initiation to metastatic colonization), sparking substantial interest in therapeutically exploiting this mechanism of cell death. Yet, despite rapid preclinical progress, clinical translation of ferroptosis-based strategies remains nascent. In this Review, we examine the major barriers to translation, including pharmacological limitations, tumour-intrinsic heterogeneity, microenvironmental and immune constraints, and gaps in current preclinical modelling. We also highlight emerging opportunities such as new ferroptosis-inducing agents, biomarker-guided patient selection and rational combinations with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted agents or immunotherapies. Finally, we outline a translational roadmap for integrating ferroptosis-based therapies into oncology practice. By defining key challenges and future directions, this Review aims to position ferroptosis as a viable therapeutic paradigm and to accelerate progress towards clinical application.
items.authors: Kang R, Liu J, Wang J, Kroemer G, Tang D.
items.title_zh: 将铁死亡转化为肿瘤学：挑战与机遇
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，当抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时发生。越来越多的证据表明，铁死亡在癌症演变的多个阶段（从肿瘤启动到转移性殖民）中，可能表现出抑制肿瘤和促进肿瘤的双重效应，这引发了对这一细胞死亡机制的治疗性利用的广泛关注。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段。本文评估了转化的主要障碍，包括药物限制、肿瘤内在异质性、微环境和免疫限制，以及当前临床前模型的不足。同时，文章强调了新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合等新兴机遇。最后，本文勾勒了将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图，旨在明确关键挑战和未来方向，将铁死亡定位为一种可行的治疗范式，加速其临床应用的进展。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡在癌症发展中具有双重效应，尽管临床转化面临挑战，但新型诱导剂和治疗组合为其应用提供了机遇。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，通常在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时发生。近年来，研究发现铁死亡在癌症演变的多个阶段中，可能同时具有抑制肿瘤和促进肿瘤的双重效应，这引发了对其作为治疗靶点的广泛关注。尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的治疗策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段，面临诸多挑战。

文章评估了转化过程中主要的障碍，包括药物限制、肿瘤内在异质性、微环境和免疫限制等因素。此外，当前的临床前模型也存在不足，限制了对铁死亡机制的深入理解和应用。尽管如此，研究者们也发现了一些新兴的机遇，例如新型铁死亡诱导剂的开发、基于生物标志物的患者选择，以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合，这些都可能为铁死亡的临床应用提供新的方向。

最后，文章勾勒出将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图，旨在明确关键挑战和未来方向，以将铁死亡定位为一种可行的治疗范式，推动其临床应用的进展。通过克服现有障碍并利用新兴机遇，铁死亡有望在肿瘤治疗中发挥重要作用。

items.title: Pro-aging effects of chronic glucocorticoid signaling.
items.body: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are essential endocrine regulators coordinating stress responsiveness, metabolic flexibility, inflammatory resolution, and circadian physiology. While acute GC fluctuations are adaptive, sustained exposure (arising from psychosocial stress, circadian disruption, obesity, chronic inflammation, neoplasms, or steroid therapy) elicits pleiotropic effects that overlap with biological aging. Prolonged GC signaling intersects with multiple hallmarks of aging by altering nutrient sensing, suppressing autophagy, impairing mitochondrial quality control, and promoting cellular senescence. In this context, the GC-responsive polypeptide ACBP/DBI (acyl-coenzyme A [CoA]-binding protein/diazepam-binding inhibitor) has emerged as a stress-induced inhibitor of macroautophagy that amplifies several metabolic and immune consequences of GC excess linked to aging phenotypes. Clinically, chronic GC elevation is associated with earlier and more severe manifestations of age-related diseases, including metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, immunosenescence, and cancer. Here, we review mechanistic links between GC signaling and systemic aging and discuss strategies to mitigate the age-accelerating consequences of persistent GC exposure.
items.authors: Lambertucci F, Castinetti F, Martins I, López-Otín C, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 慢性糖皮质激素信号的促衰老效应
items.summary_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节应激反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。虽然急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续暴露（如心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗）会引发与生物衰老重叠的多重效应。长期GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老等方式与衰老的多个标志相交。GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，放大了与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。临床上，慢性GC升高与代谢综合症、骨质疏松、肌肉减少症、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现相关。本文回顾了GC信号与全身衰老之间的机制联系，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露加速衰老后果的策略。
items.l1_lead: 慢性糖皮质激素信号通过影响代谢、抑制自噬和促进细胞衰老，与多种年龄相关疾病的发生和加重密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节应激反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。尽管急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续的GC暴露，如心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗，会引发与生物衰老相关的多重效应。长期的GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老等机制，与衰老的多个标志相互作用。

在这一过程中，GC反应性多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，进一步放大了与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。临床研究表明，慢性GC水平升高与多种年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现密切相关，包括代谢综合症、骨质疏松、肌肉减少症、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等。

本文回顾了GC信号与全身衰老之间的机制联系，强调了持续GC暴露对衰老加速的影响，并探讨了减轻这一影响的潜在策略。这些发现为理解慢性糖皮质激素信号在衰老过程中的作用提供了重要的理论基础，并为未来的干预措施指明了方向。通过深入研究GC信号与衰老之间的关系，可以为开发新的治疗策略以应对与衰老相关的疾病提供新的思路。

items.title: Immunobiological mechanisms of action of oncolytic peptides.
items.body: Oncolytic peptides (OLPs) constitute an emerging class of immunotherapeutics that combine direct cancer cell lysis with immune activation. Indeed, OLPs induce rapid immunogenic cell death by disrupting intracellular membranes, which culminates with the abundant release of malignant cell contents including immunostimulatory danger-associated molecular patterns. This results in the engagement of innate immune sensors that potently activate dendritic cells, leading to the cross-priming of tumor-specific T lymphocytes that mediate systemic anticancer immunity. Through such a dual mechanism, OLPs can remodel the tumor microenvironment and overcome resistance to therapy as promoted by intratumoral heterogeneity, hence representing optimal combinatorial partners for immune checkpoint inhibitors. Some OLPs have also shown remarkable clinical efficacy. For instance, LTX-315 (studied as VP-315 in basal cell carcinoma (BCC)) has recently been shown to enable complete and durable responses in patients with BCC, and emerging evidence points to a significant activity of LTX-315 in immunologically cold tumors. Here, we summarize recent mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical advances in OLP development, underscoring their potential as a versatile and powerful modality of cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Kepp O, Deng X, Xue E, Sveinbjørnsson B, Rekdal Ø, Galluzzi L, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽的免疫生物学作用机制
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic Peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，结合了直接癌细胞裂解与免疫激活的特性。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，导致恶性细胞内容物的丰富释放，包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式。这一过程激活了先天免疫传感器，有效激活树突状细胞，进而促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，介导全身抗癌免疫。通过这种双重机制，OLPs能够重塑肿瘤微环境，克服由肿瘤内异质性引起的治疗抵抗，因此成为免疫检查点抑制剂的理想组合伙伴。一些OLPs显示出显著的临床疗效，例如LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）已被证明能在患者中实现完全和持久的反应，且新兴证据表明LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中具有显著活性。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调其作为癌症免疫治疗的多功能和强大手段的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤溶解肽通过诱导免疫原性细胞死亡和激活免疫系统，展现出在癌症免疫治疗中的多功能性和显著临床疗效，成为理想的治疗组合伙伴。
items.l2_summary:
肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic Peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，具有直接裂解癌细胞和激活免疫系统的双重特性。OLPs通过破坏癌细胞的内膜，诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，导致恶性细胞内容物的释放，这些内容物包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式（DAMPs），从而有效激活先天免疫传感器。这一过程不仅激活了树突状细胞，还促进了肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，进而介导全身抗癌免疫反应。通过这种机制，OLPs能够重塑肿瘤微环境，克服肿瘤内异质性所引起的治疗抵抗，因此被视为免疫检查点抑制剂的理想组合伙伴。

在临床研究中，一些OLPs显示出显著的疗效。例如，LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）已被证明能够在患者中实现完全和持久的反应。此外，最新的证据表明，LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也表现出显著的活性。这些研究结果强调了OLPs在癌症免疫治疗中的多功能性和强大潜力，表明其在未来的癌症治疗中可能发挥重要作用。本文总结了OLPs开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，突出了其作为一种新型免疫治疗手段的前景。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了涉及双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）的酶催化反应，重点探讨了高选择性在复杂天然分子生物合成中的重要性。进化通常促使酶偏向形成特定异构体，而非众多其他潜在分子。近期发现的多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象表明，动态因素对选择性的影响。PTSB使得单一的双模态过渡态能够生成多个产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同。双模态过渡态产生的选择性无法完全用过渡态理论解释。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解在包含分叉的系统中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性。本文总结了酶催化反应的最新进展，阐明了酶如何控制此类反应中的选择性。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了双模态过渡态在酶催化反应中的重要性，强调动态因素和多重后过渡态分叉对产物选择性的影响，挑战传统的过渡态理论。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）在酶催化反应中的应用与挑战，特别强调了在复杂天然分子生物合成中高选择性的重要性。研究表明，进化过程通常使得酶倾向于生成特定的异构体，而非众多其他可能的分子。近期的发现揭示了多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象，这一现象表明动态因素在选择性中发挥了重要作用。PTSB的存在使得一个双模态过渡态能够生成多个不同的产物，这一机制与传统的能量控制理论存在显著差异。

值得注意的是，双模态过渡态所产生的选择性并不能完全用过渡态理论来解释，这提示我们需要更深入的理解。为此，计算化学家正在开发新技术，以探讨在包含分叉的系统中，哪些分子结构和振动因素主导了产物的选择性。这些研究不仅为我们提供了酶催化反应的最新进展，也阐明了酶在控制反应选择性方面的复杂机制。

总体而言，双模态过渡态的研究为理解酶催化反应中的选择性提供了新的视角，同时也面临着如何将这些新发现与现有理论相结合的挑战。这一领域的进一步探索将有助于推动生物合成反应的优化与应用，尤其是在合成复杂天然分子方面的潜力。

items.title: Hierarchical endpoints and win statistics for geromedicine trials.
items.body: Geroscience has advanced rapidly, yet its clinical translation remains limited. A central barrier is the lack of trial outcomes that capture the multidimensional effects of geroprotective interventions while meeting clinical and regulatory standards. Mortality is objective and regulatorily salient but often impractical. By contrast, surrogate measures of healthspan improve feasibility and may better reflect the quality of extended life, but they are generally considered soft endpoints that require further validation. Here, we propose hierarchical composite endpoints using time-to-worst-event analysis as a pragmatic and scientifically sound compromise. Participant pairs are compared using win statistics according to a prespecified clinical hierarchy, in which more severe and objective clinical events are prioritized, while health surrogates and biomarkers contribute information at lower tiers. When outcome selection, ordering and tie rules are clinically and mechanistically justified and agreed with regulators, this approach may improve geromedicine trial efficiency and allow overall treatment effects to be captured without compromising clinical priorities.
items.authors: Abdellatif M, Kim Y, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 老年医学试验的分层终点与胜利统计
items.summary_zh: 老年科学（Geroscience）发展迅速，但其临床转化仍受限。主要障碍在于缺乏能够捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时满足临床和监管标准。死亡率作为客观且具有监管重要性的指标，往往不切实际。相比之下，健康寿命（healthspan）的替代性指标提高了可行性，可能更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。本文提出使用时间至最差事件分析的分层复合终点，作为务实且科学合理的折衷方案。根据预先设定的临床层级，比较参与者对的胜利统计，其中更严重和客观的临床事件被优先考虑，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法可能提高老年医学试验的效率，并在不妥协临床优先事项的情况下捕捉整体治疗效果。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出通过分层复合终点分析，结合健康寿命和临床事件，提升老年医学试验的效率与有效性，以更好反映老年保护干预的多维效果。
items.l2_summary:
老年科学（Geroscience）近年来发展迅速，但在临床转化方面仍面临诸多挑战，主要障碍在于缺乏能够全面捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时又能满足临床和监管标准。传统上，死亡率作为一个客观且具有监管重要性的指标，常常被认为不够切实际。相较之下，健康寿命（healthspan）作为一种替代性指标，能够更好地反映延长生命的质量，然而它通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种使用时间至最差事件分析的分层复合终点的方法，作为一种务实且科学合理的折衷方案。

该方法根据预先设定的临床层级，比较参与者的胜利统计，其中更严重和客观的临床事件被优先考虑，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。这种分层设计不仅能够提高老年医学试验的效率，还能够在不妥协临床优先事项的情况下，捕捉整体治疗效果。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化，并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法的有效性将进一步得到验证。

通过这种创新的分层终点设计，研究者能够更好地平衡临床需求与监管要求，从而推动老年医学领域的研究进展，最终实现对老年人群体的更有效的健康干预。这一方法的提出，标志着老年医学试验设计的一个重要进步，可能为未来的临床研究提供新的方向和思路。

items.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
items.body: Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) combine the target specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of small-molecule payloads. In recent years ADCs have emerged as a clinically validated component of modern precision oncology. To date, more than a dozen ADCs have received FDA approval for oncologic indications, with additional agents approved regionally and hundreds of ADC-based regimens in clinical development. Collectively, these therapies have demonstrated clinical benefit across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including significant overall survival improvements in advanced phase clinical trials. In this Trial Watch, we provide an overview on available ADCs from early preclinical development to current clinical applications. We also summarize design principles underpinning clinically successful ADCs, including epitope targeting, linker chemistry, payload toxicity and drug-to-antibody ratio, and discuss how these features can influence pharmacokinetics, intracellular trafficking, bystander effect and toxicity. Finally, we discuss results from advanced-stage clinical trials and approved agents to define future directions.
items.authors: Doffe F, Deng X, Shen Z, Xue E, Schauer K, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 抗体药物偶联物在癌症治疗中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合了单克隆抗体的靶向特异性和小分子药物的细胞毒性。近年来，ADCs已成为现代精准肿瘤学的临床验证组成部分。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得FDA批准用于肿瘤适应症，并且在全球范围内有更多的药物获得区域性批准，数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在临床开发中。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中显示出临床益处，包括在晚期临床试验中显著改善总体生存率。本文概述了从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的ADCs，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则，如表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性和药物与抗体比率，讨论了这些特征如何影响药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性。最后，讨论了晚期临床试验的结果和已批准药物，以确定未来的发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）在癌症治疗中展现出显著的临床益处，已获得多种FDA批准，并在精准肿瘤学中发挥重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）是一种结合了单克隆抗体靶向特异性与小分子药物细胞毒性的创新治疗方式，近年来在癌症治疗中取得了显著进展。ADCs已成为现代精准肿瘤学的重要组成部分，目前已有十多种ADCs获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的批准用于多种肿瘤适应症，并且在全球范围内，更多的ADCs也获得了区域性批准。此外，数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在进行临床开发，显示出其在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中的临床益处，尤其是在晚期临床试验中，ADCs显著改善了患者的总体生存率。

本文回顾了ADCs从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的历程，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则。这些设计原则包括表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性以及药物与抗体的比率等，这些特征对ADCs的药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性等方面均有重要影响。通过对这些设计原则的深入分析，研究者能够更好地理解ADCs的作用机制及其在临床应用中的表现。

最后，本文讨论了晚期临床试验的结果以及已获批准的ADCs，以此为基础探讨未来的发展方向。随着对ADCs的研究不断深入，预计将会有更多创新的治疗方案问世，为癌症患者提供更有效的治疗选择。ADCs的成功应用不仅为精准肿瘤学的发展奠定了基础，也为未来的癌症治疗提供了新的思路和希望。

items.title: Exploring Splicing-Energy Axis Associations to Diet and Longevity.
items.body: There is increasing evidence that nutrient composition, even without lowering total calorie intake, can shape lifespan through mechanisms independent of mitochondrial regulation. Brandon and colleagues recently reported that a low-protein, high-carbohydrate (LPHC) diet enriched with non-digestible cellulose, extends lifespan in mice by shifting the liver proteome through altered RNA splicing, a response different from the mitochondrial improvements typically seen with caloric restriction. The authors' findings support the "energy-splicing resilience axis," which proposes that changes in splicing help cells adapt to energetic and nutritional stress. We discuss how diet influences spliceosomal components such as SRSF1, linking nutrient sensing, AMPK signaling, and tissue-specific resilience pathways. We also consider the splicing paradox in aging, where beneficial isoforms increase despite a concomitant increase in splicing errors. Understanding how dietary and pharmacologic interventions modulate splicing may shed light on strategies to maintain homeostatic proteomes and support healthy longevity.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 探讨剪接-能量轴与饮食及寿命的关系
items.summary_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，营养成分的变化，即使不降低总热量摄入，也能通过与线粒体调控无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事最近报道，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食能够通过改变RNA剪接，改变小鼠肝脏蛋白组，从而延长其寿命。这一反应与通常通过热量限制观察到的线粒体改善不同。作者的研究支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）的观点，认为剪接的变化帮助细胞适应能量和营养压力。文章讨论了饮食如何影响剪接体成分如SRSF1，连接营养感知、AMPK信号通路和组织特异性韧性通路。同时，文章还考虑了衰老中的剪接悖论，即有益的异构体增加的同时，剪接错误也随之增加。理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新策略。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，低蛋白高碳水化合物饮食通过改变RNA剪接影响小鼠寿命，支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”理论，揭示饮食对细胞适应能量和营养压力的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，越来越多的研究表明，饮食中的营养成分变化，即使不降低总热量摄入，也能通过与线粒体调控无关的机制影响生物体的寿命。Brandon及其同事的研究发现，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食能够通过改变RNA剪接，进而影响小鼠肝脏的蛋白组，从而延长其寿命。这一发现与通常通过热量限制观察到的线粒体改善机制有所不同，提示我们在探讨饮食与寿命关系时，不能仅仅依赖于热量摄入的变化。

作者提出了“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）的概念，认为RNA剪接的变化能够帮助细胞更好地适应能量和营养的压力。文章深入探讨了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，例如SRSF1，这些成分与营养感知、AMPK信号通路以及组织特异性韧性通路密切相关。这些机制的相互作用可能为细胞在面对不同营养状态时提供了调节能力。

此外，文章还提到了衰老过程中的剪接悖论，即在衰老过程中，虽然有益的异构体数量增加，但剪接错误的发生率也随之上升。这一现象提示我们在研究衰老与剪接的关系时，需要综合考虑不同剪接形式对细胞功能的影响。

理解饮食和药物干预如何调节RNA剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新的策略。这一研究不仅为我们提供了新的视角来审视饮食对寿命的影响，也为未来的健康干预措施提供了潜在的方向。通过进一步探索能量-剪接韧性轴的机制，我们或许能够找到更有效的方式来促进健康老龄化。

items.title: Mitochondrial quality control in human ageing and longevity.
items.body: Mitochondria play central roles in cellular metabolism and in key processes such as inflammation, stress response, cell death and signalling. Mitochondrial quality control (MQC) mechanisms continuously monitor organelle integrity and function, and repair or eliminate damaged mitochondria to replace them with newly formed, healthy organelles. MQC is particularly important under metabolic or environmental stress conditions. Failure of MQC paves the way to chronic diseases, such as diabetes, metabolic syndromes and immunosenescence. This Review summarizes our current understanding of MQC biology in the context of healthy human longevity. We explore the regulation of MQC in physiological conditions and explain how the dysregulation of MQC in ageing negatively impacts systemic metabolism and immune function. We discuss emerging therapeutic strategies-such as NAD + , AMPK activators and caloric restriction-that maintain a robust MQC to improve metabolic resilience and illustrate how preclinical and clinical studies can leverage MQC as a potential gerotherapeutic target.
items.title_zh: 线粒体质量控制与人类衰老及长寿
items.summary_zh: 线粒体在细胞代谢、炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键过程中发挥核心作用。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial Quality Control, MQC）机制持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，修复或清除受损线粒体，以新形成的健康线粒体替代它们。MQC在代谢或环境压力条件下尤为重要。MQC的失效可能导致慢性疾病，如糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老。本文综述了MQC生物学在健康人类长寿背景下的当前理解，探讨了MQC在生理条件下的调控，并解释了衰老中MQC失调如何对全身代谢和免疫功能产生负面影响。我们讨论了新兴的治疗策略，如NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制，这些策略有助于维持强健的MQC，以改善代谢韧性，并展示了如何通过临床前和临床研究将MQC作为潜在的衰老治疗靶点。
items.l1_lead: 线粒体质量控制机制对维持细胞功能至关重要，其失效与衰老及慢性疾病密切相关，改善MQC有望成为延缓衰老的治疗策略。
items.l2_summary:
线粒体在细胞的代谢、炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键生理过程中扮演着核心角色。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial Quality Control, MQC）机制负责持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，能够修复或清除受损的线粒体，并用新形成的健康线粒体替代它们。这一机制在应对代谢或环境压力时尤为重要，然而MQC的失效可能导致多种慢性疾病的发生，如糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老等。

在健康人类长寿的背景下，MQC的生物学机制受到越来越多的关注。研究表明，MQC在生理条件下的调控对维持细胞功能至关重要，而衰老过程中MQC的失调则会对全身的代谢和免疫功能产生负面影响。这种失调不仅影响细胞的能量代谢，还可能导致炎症反应的增强和免疫系统的衰退，从而加速衰老过程。

为了改善MQC的功能，研究者们探讨了一些新兴的治疗策略，包括NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制等。这些策略被认为能够维持强健的MQC，从而改善代谢韧性，延缓衰老进程。临床前和临床研究的结果显示，通过调节MQC，可以作为潜在的衰老治疗靶点，为人类的健康长寿提供新的思路和方法。

综上所述，MQC在维持细胞健康和延缓衰老方面具有重要意义，其失调与多种慢性疾病密切相关。通过进一步的研究和临床应用，MQC有望成为未来抗衰老治疗的重要方向。

items.title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
items.body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.
items.authors: Lefaucheur JP, Colzi C, Hollander E, Pampaloni I, Van Ameringen M, Baeken C, Fusar-Poli P, Arango C, Fontenelle LF, Batail JM, Brunoni AR, Nicolini H, Haffen E, Soriano-Mas C, Rodriguez CI, Dell'Osso BM, Vieta E, Sauvage

items.title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 重度抑郁症（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）产生耐药性。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD治疗中显示出良好前景，通常采用每周五天每天一次的“标准”方案。主要使用的两种模式为高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在更短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快效果。本文系统性文献回顾分析了23篇比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的研究，重点关注aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及刺激参数的影响，如刺激模式、间隔时间、剂量和皮层靶向方法。尽管部分研究未发现aTMS与标准或假刺激之间的显著差异，但也有研究指出aTMS的潜在优势。
items.l1_lead: 加速TMS（aTMS）在抑郁症治疗中显示出潜在优势，尽管部分研究未发现其与标准或假刺激rTMS之间的显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
重度抑郁症（MDD）是全球健康领域面临的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）产生耐药性，导致治疗效果不佳。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）作为一种新兴的治疗手段，在MDD/TRD的治疗中展现出良好的前景，通常采用每周五天、每天一次的“标准”方案。主要的刺激模式包括高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），主要针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。为了提高治疗效果或加快效果，加速TMS（aTMS）方案通过在更短的时间内提供更多的刺激，旨在改善治疗结果。

本文对23篇比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的研究进行了系统性文献回顾，重点分析了aTMS在抑郁症治疗中的有效性及其刺激参数的影响，包括刺激模式、间隔时间、剂量和皮层靶向方法。尽管部分研究未能发现aTMS与标准或假刺激之间存在显著差异，但也有研究指出aTMS可能具有潜在的优势。这些研究结果表明，aTMS在某些情况下可能会提高治疗效果，尤其是在特定的刺激参数下。

总体而言，尽管目前的研究结果尚不一致，但aTMS作为一种新兴的治疗方法，仍然值得进一步探索，以期为重度抑郁症患者提供更有效的治疗选择。未来的研究应继续关注不同刺激参数对治疗效果的影响，以便更好地理解aTMS的潜力和应用前景。

items.title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
items.body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
items.authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
items.title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），包括焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），在青少年中常见。本系统评估旨在探讨青少年内化障碍与执行功能（EF）之间的关联。研究通过对Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science的系统检索，筛选出2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章。结果显示，在22项研究中，执行功能的表现差异主要在抑郁障碍青少年中最为明显，任务基础的抑制能力在抑郁障碍中得分最低（n = 5）。其他内化障碍的结果则较为混杂。有三项研究发现强迫症（OCD）和焦虑障碍的抑制表现有所改善。最后，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究显示在执行功能各领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现良好相对立。
items.l1_lead: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能存在显著关联，抑郁障碍青少年在执行功能表现上最为突出，尤其在任务基础的抑制能力方面得分最低。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在系统评估青少年内化障碍（INTs）与执行功能（EF）之间的关联，特别关注焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD）在这一关系中的表现。通过对Medline、Psych-INFO、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索，研究筛选出自2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章进行分析。结果显示，在22项研究中，执行功能的表现差异在抑郁障碍青少年中最为明显，尤其是在任务基础的抑制能力方面，抑郁障碍青少年的得分最低（n = 5）。这一发现表明，抑郁障碍可能对青少年的执行功能产生显著负面影响。

此外，其他内化障碍的研究结果则较为混杂，部分研究显示强迫症（OCD）和焦虑障碍的抑制表现有所改善，提示不同类型的内化障碍可能在执行功能的影响上存在差异。值得注意的是，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究显示，在执行功能的各个领域中，青少年普遍存在显著困难，其中3项研究的结果与任务表现良好的情况相对立，进一步强调了内化障碍对青少年执行功能的潜在影响。

综上所述，研究表明抑郁障碍青少年在执行功能方面存在明显的不足，尤其是在抑制能力的任务表现上，而其他内化障碍的影响则较为复杂。这一系统评估为理解青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间的关系提供了重要的实证依据，提示在临床干预中需关注青少年执行功能的评估与改善。

items.title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
items.body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.

items.title_zh: PTSD患者脑结构异常的全脑体素分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学分析。研究显示，PTSD患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的杏仁核和海马体等区域的灰质（GM）和白质（WM）体积较小。我们使用来自ENIGMA-PGC PTSD工作组的神经影像数据，对36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像扫描进行标准化处理，分析了PTSD患者与对照组之间的体素差异。结果表明，PTSD患者在额叶、颞叶和小脑的灰质体积显著减少，尤其是在左侧小脑（Hedges' g = 0.22, p校正 = .001），同时小脑的白质体积也较小（峰值Hedges' g = 0.14, p校正 = .008）。这些结构异常可能与创伤暴露相关，提示其特异性。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的脑区，如杏仁核和海马体，存在显著的灰质和白质体积减少，可能与创伤暴露相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素（voxel-based）基础的形态学分析，旨在探讨PTSD患者在脑部结构上的特征。研究结果表明，PTSD患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的杏仁核和海马体等区域的灰质（GM）和白质（WM）体积显著较小。研究使用了来自ENIGMA-PGC PTSD工作组的神经影像数据，对36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像扫描进行了标准化处理，比较了PTSD患者与对照组之间的体素差异。

具体而言，研究发现PTSD患者在额叶、颞叶和小脑的灰质体积显著减少，尤其是在左侧小脑的灰质体积减少程度较为明显，Hedges' g值为0.22，经过校正后p值为0.001。同时，小脑的白质体积也显示出显著减少，峰值Hedges' g为0.14，校正后的p值为0.008。这些结构异常可能与创伤暴露密切相关，提示其具有特异性。

综上所述，本研究通过全脑体素分析揭示了PTSD患者在特定脑区的结构性变化，强调了这些变化与创伤经历之间的联系，为理解PTSD的神经生物学基础提供了重要的证据。

items.title: The meltdown pathway: A multidisciplinary account of autistic meltdowns.
items.body: Autistic meltdowns are fits of intense frustration and often physical violence elicited by sensory and cognitive stressors. Despite the high prevalence of meltdowns among autistic individuals, the neural mechanisms that underlie this response are not yet well understood. This has thus far hampered progress toward a dedicated therapeutic intervention-beyond traditional medications-that limits their frequency and severity. Here, we aim to initiate an interdisciplinary dialogue on the etiology of sensory meltdowns. In doing so, we frame meltdowns as a consequence of underlying chronic hypervigilance and acute hyperreactivity to objectively benign stressors driven by differences in the insular cortex-a multimodal integration hub that adapts autonomic state and behavior to meet environmental demands. We first discuss meltdowns through the lens of neurophysiology and argue that intrainsular hypoconnectivity engenders vagal withdrawal and sympathetic hyperarousal in autism, driving chronic hypervigilance and reducing the threshold of stressors those with autism can tolerate before experiencing a meltdown. Next, we turn to neuropsychology and present evidence that meltdowns reflect a difference in how contextual evidence, particularly social cues, is integrated when acutely assessing ambiguous signs of danger in the environment-a process termed neuroception. Finally, we build on contemporary predictive coding accounts of autism to argue that meltdowns may be ultimately driven by differences in sensory attenuation and coherent deep inference within the interoceptive hierarchy, possibly linked to oxytocin deficiency during infancy. Throughout, we synthesize each perspective to construct a multidisciplinary, insula-based model of meltdowns. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2025 APA, all rights reserved).
items.authors: Soden PA, Bhat A, Anderson AK, Friston K.
items.title_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃的多学科探讨
items.summary_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现。尽管自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率较高，但其神经机制尚不明确，这限制了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话。我们将情绪崩溃视为慢性过度警觉和对客观无害压力源的急性过度反应的结果，这与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异有关。我们首先从神经生理学的角度讨论情绪崩溃，认为岛叶内连接不足导致自闭症中的迷走神经抑制和交感神经过度兴奋，进而驱动慢性过度警觉，降低自闭症患者在经历情绪崩溃前能承受的压力阈值。接着，我们转向神经心理学，提供证据表明情绪崩溃反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是社会线索的整合方式存在差异，这一过程称为神经感知（neuroception）。
items.l1_lead: 自闭症情绪崩溃源于感官和认知压力引发的过度反应，涉及岛叶皮层的神经机制差异，影响个体对压力的承受能力。
items.l2_summary:
自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现，尽管在自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率较高，但其神经机制尚不明确，这限制了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，将情绪崩溃视为慢性过度警觉和对客观无害压力源的急性过度反应的结果，并与岛叶皮层（insular cortex）的差异相关联。

从神经生理学的角度来看，情绪崩溃的发生与岛叶内连接不足有关，这种不足导致自闭症患者的迷走神经抑制和交感神经过度兴奋，从而驱动慢性过度警觉。这种状态降低了自闭症患者在经历情绪崩溃前能够承受的压力阈值，意味着他们对环境中潜在压力源的敏感性显著提高。

在神经心理学方面，研究提供了证据，表明情绪崩溃反映了自闭症个体在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是在整合社会线索的方式上存在差异。这一过程被称为神经感知（neuroception），它揭示了自闭症患者在社会交往和环境适应中的挑战。

综上所述，情绪崩溃的多学科探讨为理解自闭症个体的情绪反应提供了新的视角，强调了神经生理和神经心理机制的相互作用。这一研究不仅为自闭症情绪崩溃的成因提供了理论基础，也为未来的干预和治疗策略的制定提供了重要的启示。

items.title: Active inference and cognitive control: Balancing deliberation and habits through precision optimization.
items.body: We advance a novel formulation of cognitive control within the active inference framework. The theory proposes that cognitive control amounts to optimising a precision parameter, which acts as a control signal and balances the contributions of deliberative and habitual components of action selection. To illustrate the theory, we simulate a driving scenario in which the driver follows a well-known route, but encounters unexpected challenges. Our simulations show that a standard active inference model can form adaptive habits; i.e., can pass from deliberative to habitual control when the context is stable, but generally fails to revert to deliberative control, when the context changes. To address this failure of context-sensitivity, we introduce a novel type of hierarchical active inference, in which a lower level is responsible for behavioural control and the higher (or meta-cognitive) level observes the belief updating of the lower level below and is responsible for cognitive control. Crucially, the meta-cognitive level can both form habits and suspend them, by controlling the (precision) parameter that prioritizes deliberative choices at the behavioural level. Furthermore, we show that several processes linked to cognitive control - such as surprise detection, cognitive conflict monitoring, control signal regulation and specification, the simulation of future outcomes and the assessment of the costs of control and mental effort - stem coherently from the free energy minimization scheme that underpins active inference. Finally, we discuss the putative neurobiology of cognitive control by simulating brain dynamics in the mesolimbic and mesocortical pathways of the dopamine system, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex and the locus coeruleus.
items.authors: Proietti R, Parr T, Tessari A, Friston K, Pezzulo G.
items.title_zh: 主动推理与认知控制：通过精度优化平衡深思与习惯
items.summary_zh: 本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论。该理论认为，认知控制的本质在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）行动选择的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景，研究表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时从深思转向习惯控制，但在环境变化时通常无法恢复到深思控制。为了解决这一上下文敏感性失效的问题，本文引入了一种新的层级主动推理，其中较低层负责行为控制，而较高层（或元认知层）观察下层的信念更新并负责认知控制。关键在于，元认知层能够形成和暂停习惯，通过控制优先考虑深思选择的精度参数。此外，本文还展示了与认知控制相关的多个过程，如惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号调节与规范、未来结果的模拟等。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新的认知控制理论，强调通过优化精度参数来平衡深思与习惯行为，以应对环境变化带来的适应性挑战。
items.l2_summary:
本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论，强调认知控制的核心在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，用以平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）行动选择的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景的实验，研究发现标准的主动推理模型能够在环境稳定时形成适应性习惯，即从深思转向习惯控制。然而，当环境发生变化时，该模型通常无法有效恢复到深思控制的状态，这揭示了上下文敏感性失效的问题。

为了解决这一问题，本文引入了一种新的层级主动推理模型，其中较低层负责具体的行为控制，而较高层（或称元认知层）则负责观察下层的信念更新并进行认知控制。元认知层的关键作用在于能够形成和暂停习惯，通过调节精度参数来优先考虑深思选择。此外，研究还展示了与认知控制相关的多个过程，包括惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号的调节与规范，以及未来结果的模拟等。这些过程共同作用，进一步丰富了对认知控制机制的理解。

总体而言，本文的研究为认知控制提供了新的视角，强调了精度参数在深思与习惯之间的平衡作用，并提出了层级主动推理的概念，以应对环境变化带来的挑战。这一理论不仅为理解人类决策过程提供了新的框架，也为未来的相关研究指明了方向。

items.title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
items.body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.
